entities.description:
{
  "dataset": "rag-golden",
  "version": 1,
  "description": "Golden RAG evaluation cases over the EOIP demo corpus (FR-RAG-005). Expected facts are canonical IDs (or unique substrings) that retrieval must surface as facts.",
  "cases": [
    {
      "id": "eoip1-trace",
      "question": "Trace EOIP-1 to its implementation code",
      "canonical_id": "urn:eoip:work:item:jira:EOIP-1",
      "expected_facts": [
        "urn:eoip:work:item:jira:EOIP-1",
        "urn:eoip:code:commit:demo:a61a4f70ab795521e00d0e63fc9d8581f334a394",
        "urn:eoip:code:symbol:demo:service.py:compute_impact",
        "urn:eoip:code:file:demo:service.py"
      ],
      "expected_evidence_min": 1,
      "strategy": "code_context"
    },
    {
      "id": "compute-impact-code",
      "question": "Which code and helpers does the compute_impact function use?",
      "canonical_id": "urn:eoip:code:symbol:demo:service.py:compute_impact",
      "expected_facts": [
        "urn:eoip:code:symbol:demo:service.py:compute_impact",
        "urn:eoip:code:symbol:demo:service.py:normalize",
        "urn:eoip:code:file:demo:service.py",
        "urn:eoip:code:dependency:demo:math"
      ],
      "expected_evidence_min": 1,
      "strategy": "code_context"
    },
    {
      "id": "repo-dependencies",
      "question": "Which external dependencies does the demo repository declare?",
      "canonical_id": "urn:eoip:code:repo:demo",
      "expected_facts": [
        "urn:eoip:code:repo:demo",
        "urn:eoip:code:dependency:demo:math",
        "urn:eoip:code:dependency:demo:json",
        "urn:eoip:code:dependency:demo:./service"
      ],
      "expected_evidence_min": 1,
      "strategy": "code_context"
    },
    {
      "id": "readme-doc",
      "question": "Which requirement does the README document?",
      "canonical_id": "urn:eoip:knowledge:document:demo:README.md",
      "expected_facts": [
        "urn:eoip:knowledge:document:demo:README.md",
        "urn:eoip:work:item:jira:EOIP-1",
        "urn:eoip:code:file:demo:service.py"
      ],
      "expected_evidence_min": 1,
      "strategy": "document_context"
    },
    {
      "id": "insufficient-evidence",
      "question": "What is blocking EOIP-404 and which code implements it?",
      "canonical_id": "urn:eoip:work:item:jira:EOIP-404",
      "expected_facts": [],
      "expected_evidence_min": 0,
      "strategy": null
    }
  ]
}
